t: This is Chrisp Street Market, the central marketplace and town centre of Poplar, connected onto East India Dock Road. It was the first purpose-built pedestrian shopping area in the United Kingdom, rebuilt as part of the 1951 Festival of Britain. The architect was Sir Frederick Gibberd, who was also a town planner and landscape designer. Gibberd is best known for Liverpool Metropolitan Cathedral, and for his work in Harlow, in Essex. Here, he planned a whole shopping centre where people could walk freely.
